choice.basis: The chart 'Renewable Energy Production by Source' shows Solar at 41.2%, which is the largest contribution source compared to Wind (29.8%), Hydroelectric (18.5%), Biomass (7.2%), and Geothermal (3.3%). The public task requires routing the largest source to priority contribution follow-up, which aligns with the Solar option.
choice.option_label: Route Solar for priority contribution follow-up
